chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.اَلْهَدِيَّةُ: a gift given to another person

ai.seo_question: How do gifts help remove resentment between people in Islamic teachings?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that giving gifts helps remove rancor and resentment between people. It highlights gift-giving as a means of strengthening affection and improving social relations.
